figurative_meaning_bn: এক সঙ্গে দুই কাজ করা; একইসাথে আনন্দভোগ ও অর্থোপার্জন বা কার্যসিদ্ধি
figurative_meaning_en: Doing two things at once; simultaneously enjoying pleasure and earning money or achieving tasks
similar_in_english: Having the best of both worlds
Killing two birds with one stone
example_sentences_in_bangla: রথযাত্রার সময় সে রথদেখা কলাবেচা করে ভালো আয় করেছে।
জীবনে রথদেখা কলাবেচা করতে হলে দক্ষতা লাগে।
example_sentences_in_english: During the Rath Yatra, he made good money by watching the chariot and selling bananas.
To succeed in life, one needs the skill to watch the chariot and sell bananas.
history: This idiom originates from the tradition during Rath Yatra festivals where vendors sell goods like bananas while watching the procession, combining religious observance with commerce.
note: Linked to Hindu festivals like Jagannath Rath Yatra, common in Bengal and Odisha regions.
